item.title: BLACKPINK’s History-Making Accomplishments: A Timeline
item.description:
[Energetic music plays in the background]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we celebrate the biggest names in K-pop! Today, we're shining the spotlight on the one and only BLACKPINK. It's hard to believe it's been over 6 years since their debut on August 8, 2016. Since then, they've been breaking records and taking the world by storm!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "Let's talk about some of their impressive achievements. They've dominated the Billboard charts, became the first K-pop girl group to perform at Coachella, and even headlined the festival as the first Asian act. They've also set new Guinness World Records and surpassed Justin Bieber in YouTube subscribers. And, they became the first artist to reach 100 million subscribers on the platform!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "But what's even more impressive is that many of these achievements happened before their debut studio album, 'The Album', was released in October 2020. Jennie, one of the group members, shared her thoughts on their success with Grammy.com, saying, 'It's very surprising to us... Every day we try to acknowledge how grateful we are, but more than the pressure, we are ready to give them back as much as they gave us.'"
[Short music transition]
Host: "And the best part? BLACKPINK is just getting started! After taking some time apart to pursue solo projects, they regrouped in 2025 for their DEADLINE World Tour, followed by the release of their album 'DEADLINE' in 2026. As they celebrate a decade since their debut, we can't wait to see what's next for this talented quartet. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!"
[Outro music plays]
